description: This file contains server-side logic for the TheorySet page in an online examination system, including event handlers for UI controls, database interactions for managing questions and courses, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the TheorySet ASP.NET page, handling UI events and database operations related to course and question management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently commented out code for session-based question number.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new question into the database, updates question number, and shows alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam details to the database and navigates to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.
